lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible on the lateral flank, organized into approximately five distinct horizontal rows. The spatial frequency of these centroids decreases (inter-blob distance increases) along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with faint horizontal bands to form a lattice. The primary high-luminance blobs are positioned at the nodal intersections of these vertical and horizontal intensity gradients.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank. These features are characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, consisting of a high-intensity dorsal edge and a low-intensity (shadowed) ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of small, faint high-luminance blobs is visible, primarily concentrated on the anterior half of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, high-luminance linear mark (potential scar) is visible on the posterior margin of the lower caudal lobe. Minor irregular notches are also present along the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated, low-luminance silhouettes are visible adhering to the ventral flank and the pectoral fin base, consistent with the presence of remoras.
